**Scope(s):** OBJECT · **Row count:** 3 ·
**Lifecycle (candidate):** DORMANT · **Layer (provisional):** LAYER-UNRESOLVED
**Notations:** PART IV ENTRY CONTRACT · **Aliases:** none recorded
**Candidate group membership (NOT an identity claim):**
- G0430: links `book-readiness-audit-part-iv-entry-contract` with `book-structure-crosswalk-six-part-proposal` — explicit agent-stated uncertainty: 'book-structure-crosswalk-six-part-proposal' POSSIBLY relates to 'book-readiness-audit-part-iv-entry-contract' (batch B0047). Note: A concrete six-Part book restructuring proposal (Discovery/Reconstruction/Architecture/The Formal Programme[new]/Implementation Specification[new]/Implications, GN-76) with a full chapter-by-chapter crosswalk of all 25 existing chapters plus new Part IV (5 ch) and Part V (9 ch) chapter lists; its decisive finding is that an implementation specification chain (objects->state->invariants->operations->transformations->evidence->governance->software->tests) is ratified through invariants/evidence(partial)/governance/software/tests but BLOCKED at operations (v0.2 names zero operations, grep-verified) and transformations (no pre/post-condition spec exists anywhere, delta-commit executes as identity K1 is K0); explicitly a proposal only -- no book file edited, BA-1..BA-6 unmodified, requires a future BOOK ARCHITECTURE v2 ratification act.

## Sources (how this label entered the ledger)
- **OBJECT-INDEX** (batch B0042, scope OBJECT): A read-only book-lane readiness/synchronization audit (HPA mandate GN-72) finds zero book-text occurrences of 'theory is complete/closed/established' across 14 produced chapters, every treated open question presented as open with no OQ resolved, and no evidence class silently upgraded (I-11/I-12 never carried to TESTED). It proposes an explicit Part IV entry contract — what Part IV may claim, may consume (only governed artifacts, never a live investigation), what is outside scope (resolving any OQ, asserting implementation correspondence for formal objects), what must exist before Part IV begins, and what must remain explicitly NOT ESTABLISHED — requiring HPA adoption before Part IV production begins.
